title: Follow-Up after Biological Mitral Valve Replacement and Comparison of Different Biological Mitral Valve Prosthesis Types
summary: How good is survival and freedom from repeat heart surgery after biological mitral valve replacement, in comparison between different prostheses?

interventions.name: Patients undergoing biological mitral valve replacement between 01.01.2024 and 31.12.2025 at the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery at the German Heart Center Munich.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Successful biological mitral valve replacement at the German Heart Center Munich between 01.01.2024 and 31.12.2025
Exclusion criteria:
Inability to attend follow-up appointments at the German Heart Center Munich
